blindness_caveat: The first pass at this gold list (Indegy, Cymptom, Bit Discovery, Ermetic) was independently researched before any 8-K text was examined. Two more real acquisitions -- Alsid and Accurics -- were then caught not by my research but by the user (a former Bit Discovery/Tenable employee) manually reading Tenable's actual 10-K tax footnote and noticing they were missing from the list I'd built. That's a real gap in my independent research, corrected here rather than left standing. Alsid/Accurics dates and prices were then confirmed via independent press sources before being added.
gold_sources: User's own manual review of Tenable's 10-K acquisitions/tax footnote, which surfaced Alsid and Accurics
note: Tenable's own acquisitions since its 2018 IPO. The Alsid/Accurics gap is itself evidence for last message's finding: the 10-K's acquisitions/tax footnote is a real, valuable discovery source distinct from 8-Ks -- but it is noisy, oblique financial-disclosure text (deferred tax benefits, valuation-allowance releases), not a clean structured list, so a parser built to extract it would need real work, not a simple keyword scan. Not yet checked whether Alsid/Accurics each generated their own standalone 8-K.
